name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. Asset, locomotion A/B, dual-sensor, two-dry-run, frozen closed-loop, sync, and local re-evaluation gates passed 71/71. Human review remains required; V2 is baseline-only. V4 preview02 passed its bounded automated forest-locomotion gates, but on 2026-08-14 Dr Sun requested faster motion and obstacle avoidance, so V4 is preserved as a change-requested baseline rather than accepted. V5 now has two identical-input passing dry runs and one frozen review candidate: 0.50 m/s SCAN command, 0.523 m/s measured planar-speed p75, five trajectories, 1.014 m primary-tree centre clearance, 0.059 m goal error, and zero collision/watchdog/protocol/reconnect events. All remote evidence is synced with exact tree-hash parity. Human V5 video review remains required; no training or real-robot work occurred.
